/lore - open or close the panel (or press your key; press it over an NPC to read about them)
/lore <question> - ask directly, e.g. /lore why is westfall so poor
/lore ctx | export | visits | stats - what Lore Forever sees, for bug reports and playtests
/lore key - choose the key that opens the panel; /lore key narrate - a key that plays narration
/lore lang - choose the language (language packs are separate add-ons)
/lore listen - read the last answer aloud; /lore narrate - narrate flights on/off
/lore narrations - every recorded narration, grouped (your starting area first)
/lore primer - dungeon primer for where you are
/lore voice - list narration voices; /lore voice <number or name> - switch (auto: default, none: game voice)
